title: Stratified adaptive sampling for derivative-free stochastic trust-region optimization
summary: There is emerging evidence that trust-region (TR) algorithms are very effective at solving derivative-free nonconvex stochastic optimization problems in which the objective function is a Monte Carlo (MC) estimate. A recent strand of methodologies adaptively adjusts the sample size of the MC estimates by keeping the estimation error below a measure of stationarity induced from the TR radius.
